'''FreiTek Incorporated''' was a relatively young company founded by ex-[[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] designers shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="EGVV" />

FreiTek quickly became a major manufacturer of military vehicles. They were open supporters of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]; their first major design, the [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighter]], was created specifically for the New Republic.<ref name="EGVV" />

Unfortunately for FreiTek, the E-wing was initially rejected by the New Republic due to its inferior weaponry systems. After forming an exclusive weapons division, the craft was accepted and was utilized frequently. FreiTek supported their R&D department by selling upgrade kits for older [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The FreiTek founders eventually took control of Incom after the corporation was liberated from the Empire. The FreiTek marque would become the weapons and avionics division of the new Incom.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
